summary_en: Tender price raised to ¥7,713/share from ¥7,600; minimum acceptance threshold reduced to 849,600 shares (29.68% S/O) from 867,000 shares (30.29% S/O); offer period extended to 28 July 2026 (52 business days total); no further changes contemplated.
title_en: Notice of Change in Acquisition Terms of Public Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of METALART CORPORATION (Securities Code: 5644) by Gerbera holdings Corporation
translation_en_brief: On 13 July 2026, Gerbera holdings Corporation announced modifications to its public tender offer for ordinary shares of METALART CORPORATION (TSE Standard Market, Code 5644), launched on 15 May 2026 with intent to acquire 100% of the target. Having reviewed shareholder takeup and related factors, the offeror raised the per-share tender price to ¥7,713 from the initial ¥7,600, designated this as final with no further changes to follow. Simultaneously, the minimum acceptance threshold was lowered to 849,600 shares (representing 29.68% ownership) from the previous 867,000 shares (30.29% ownership). The offer period was extended to 28 July 2026, comprising 52 business days in aggregate. The offeror confirmed it will not extend the period further absent a statutory obligation to do so.
